summary: Frontend E2E testing of new React /next app (Kinntegra Phase 2). All 7 requested scenarios PASS. Login two-step flow works, invalid credentials show inline error and block progression, dashboard renders live Azure SQL data with all expected counts, charts render, logout returns to signin, protected route redirects to signin, and legacy Angular app still loads at root URL (regression intact).

issues: X-axis category labels overlap and get clipped/rotated awkwardly for long strings like 'Introduction - Comprehensive Analysis - Account Opening'. Consider truncation, angled labels with more bottom margin, or a legend.

Live data shows only a single 'Pending' segment; donut renders as a solid ring with no visible split. Not a bug (reflects real data) but consider showing a count/percentage label inside the donut for clarity.

action_items: (Optional) Improve X-axis label rendering on Client Onboarding chart to avoid clipping.
(Optional) Display numeric total inside Trade Log Status donut center.
critical_code_review_comments: All required data-testid attributes present and functional.
Sensitive: on invalid credentials the error text 'Invalid email or password.' is generic - fine for security, matches Kinntegra tone.
Dashboard fetches 3 endpoints in parallel; page renders in ~2-3s which is acceptable for pymssql cold connections.
seed_data_creation: None - live Azure SQL data used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New React app is served at /next (react-router basename='/next'). Data-testids present on login form, PIN form, dashboard cards/charts, topbar, and logout. Live Azure SQL numbers observed: Total=1,817 Individual=1,602 NRI=115 Corporate=24 Minor=76. Topbar shows 'Super Admin / SA'. Angular regression: root URL returns page with title 'Kinntegrawebapp' - untouched.
